core_categories: Medical Supplies; Medical Equipment; Consumables; Scrubs and Shoes; Furnishing; Education and Student Supplies
specialty_focus: Medshop Australia is an online distributor of medical supplies, equipment, and healthcare services, serving hospitals, clinics, government agencies, universities, and the general public. It specializes in nursing and allied health products, including affordable tools for student nurses and professionals, and is an NDIS provider for mobility and participant care goods. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
